title: A video window says its name, size, length and whether it is saved in its title bar
goal: The video mocks put one quiet line in the title bar: the project name in bold, the picture size, the length, and saved or edited, so a person always knows which edit they are in and whether closing will lose anything. The app shows none of that today, which matters more now that an edit can be saved as a named project.
notes: Found in the side-by-side for a-video-edit-can-be-saved-as-a-project-and-opene (2026-09-24). Mock spec: docs/design/mocks/shared/AGENTS.md ~line 452 (data-shell: text before the first dot is bolded) and data-shell on video.html, video-captions.html (capDirty) and video-audio.html (aDirty). App today: the title bar shows the traffic lights and the Everything mode picker, no document name (see /tmp/photonz-playtest/a-video-edit-saves-as-a-project-walk/9-reopened-sc.png). Readable state: EditorState.windowTitle, hasUnsavedChanges, documentLengthMS, document.canvasSize.
acceptance: At Next defaults, an opened recording shows its file name, picture size and length in the title bar, as video.html draws it (launch-teaser · 1920 x 1080 · 0:15 · saved)
After a cut the line says edited, and after File > Save As it shows the project name and saved
The line sits where the mock puts it and in the mock type weight and colour (name bold, the rest faint), with no new control added to the title bar
A walk at Next defaults photographs the line before and after a save, and the audit sets it beside the video.html title bar
